```{r}
data_fitting <- base::do.call(
  base::rbind,
  base::lapply(
    replay.fitting[[1]],
    function(subject) {
      subject[["multiRL.summary"]]@data
    }
  )
) 
```

```{r}
plot_setsize_analysis(data_fitting)

ggplot2::ggsave(filename = "../SetSize_Effect_Human.png", width = 8, height = 6)

plot_error_analysis(data_fitting, "Action")

ggplot2::ggsave(filename = "../Error_Effect_Human.png", width = 8, height = 6)

plot_avoid_error(data_fitting)

ggplot2::ggsave(filename = "../Avoid_Effect_Human.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```
